subject.title: fix(android): restore the complete Wear companion experience

question: Should OpenClaw make the restored five-page Wear companion UI, Phone-proxied agent/Gateway controls, and Watch-local theme/auto-speak persistence the supported companion contract?
rationale: The patch is technically bounded and includes compatibility safeguards, but it materially expands the Watch interaction model and establishes durable local preferences; the repository policy requires owner-visible judgment for such compatibility-sensitive state and protocol behavior.

options.title: Approve the restored contract
options.body: Confirm the full companion interface and two Watch-local preferences as supported behavior, then refresh and land the PR against current main.

options.title: Keep the reduced companion scope
options.body: Decline the expanded control surface and close or narrow the branch to only behavior already intended for the shipped Wear experience.

recommendation.title: Approve the restored contract
recommendation.body: Confirm the full companion interface and two Watch-local preferences as supported behavior, then refresh and land the PR against current main.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the available Wear implementation history, but an Android/Wear owner should be added during maintainer review because current-main ownership could not be verified here.
